items.title: Ran Blake interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 16, 2021
items.q: It was the Antibes Festival and we did “All About Ronnie” for one piece.

ctx.x: It was the Antibes Festival and we did “All About Ronnie” for one piece.

Okay. So you came out and you didn’t have any music, which is not that surprising, but at some point in the song you are looking at her waiting for her to hit a note, and I’ve done some accompanying, and so in my head I’m wondering does Ran know what note she’s about to sing and is it guiding his chord or whatever, choice, what he’s about to play?
